options.name: binary_path
options.description: The path of a helm binary to use.

options.name: chart_ref
options.description: Chart reference with repo prefix, for example, C(nginx-stable/nginx-ingress). Path to a packaged chart. Path to an unpacked chart directory. Absolute URL.

options.name: chart_repo_url
options.description: Chart repository URL where the requested chart is located.

options.name: chart_version
options.description: Chart version to use. If this is not specified, the latest version is installed.

options.name: dependency_update
options.description: Run helm dependency update before the operation. The I(dependency_update) option require the add of C(dependencies) block in C(Chart.yaml/requirements.yaml) file. For more information please visit U(https://helm.sh/docs/helm/helm_dependency/)

options.name: disable_hook
options.description: Prevent hooks from running during install.

options.name: include_crds
options.description: Include custom resource descriptions in rendered templates.

options.name: insecure_registry
options.description: Skip TLS certificate checks for the chart download

options.name: output_dir
options.description: Output directory where templates will be written. If the directory already exists, it will be overwritten.

options.name: plain_http
options.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS when working with OCI registries Requires Helm >= 3.13.0

options.name: release_name
options.description: Release name to use in rendered templates.

options.name: set_values
options.description: Values to pass to chart configuration.

options.name: show_only
options.description: Only show manifests rendered from the given templates.

options.name: update_repo_cache
options.description: Run C(helm repo update) before the operation. Can be run as part of the template generation or as a separate step.

options.name: values_files
options.description: Value files to pass to chart. Paths will be read from the target host's filesystem, not the host running ansible. I(values_files) option is evaluated before I(values) option if both are used. Paths are evaluated in the order the paths are specified.
